We need to write test cases for exception scenarios not covered. Existing cases cover default behavior, customizer exception, null executionContext, overriding core fields, replacement, customizer invoked once, null attribute value, prepopulated map. Need to find other possible exception scenarios in putAnnotation method.

Method code:

protected void putAnnotation(ExecutionContext executionContext, Consumer<JsonNodeAnnotation.Builder> customizer) {
    JsonNodeAnnotation.Builder builder = JsonNodeAnnotation.builder()
        .evaluationPath(this.evaluationPath)
        .schemaLocation(this.schemaLocation)
        .keyword(getKeyword());
    customizer.accept(builder);
    executionContext.getAnnotations().put(builder.build());
}

Potential NPEs: if customizer is null -> NullPointerException when calling accept. Also if builder.build() returns something that causes exception? Possibly if builder is null (not). If executionContext.getAnnotations() returns null -> NPE. If executionContext is not null but getAnnotations returns null. Also if builder.build() fails due to missing required fields? But builder is prepopulated with evaluationPath, schemaLocation, keyword; maybe they could be null causing IllegalStateException? Need to inspect JsonNodeAnnotation.Builder implementation, but assume builder.build() may throw IllegalStateException if required fields missing. However default fields are set; but if validator's fields are null (e.g., evaluationPath null) maybe builder accepts null? Could cause NPE later. So test scenario: executionContext not null but getAnnotations() returns null, leading to NPE on put.

Also scenario: customizer modifies builder to set null schemaLocation? Might cause NPE later when building? Not sure.

Also scenario: customizer throws checked exception? Consumer accept can't throw checked, only runtime.

Also scenario: executionContext is a mock that throws exception when getAnnotations() called.

Thus we need to design test cases covering:

- customizer null -> NPE
- executionContext.getAnnotations() returns null -> NPE
- executionContext.getAnnotations().put throws exception (e.g., underlying map throws UnsupportedOperationException) -> propagate
- builder.build() throws IllegalStateException if required fields missing (simulate by customizer clearing required fields). Need ability to set builder's evaluationPath to null? Might be allowed; but maybe builder.validate() throws IllegalStateException if any required attribute missing. We'll assume that.

Thus create groups: "putAnnotation - null customizer", "putAnnotation - executionContext with null annotation map", "putAnnotation - annotation map throws exception", "putAnnotation - builder missing required fields leading to IllegalStateException".
